basic_info.description: Charming and cozy well maintained home located in San Francisco's vibrant Bayview neighborhood. This 3 bedroom, 1 bathroom home offers 1,050 sq ft of living space and sits on a spacious 2,500 sq ft lot. The home provides a welcoming atmosphere, perfect for both relaxation and entertaining. The generous lot offers ample outdoor space, ideal for gardening or enjoying the weather. Backyard has chayote pear tree, walnut tree, fig tree, and lemon tree. Conveniently located with easy access to public transit, shopping, and major freeways, this home is perfect for those seeking a blend of comfort and accessibility. Don't miss the opportunity to make this charming gem yours!
